name: Apart Florida, Fam. Tschallener
beschreibung: The Apart Florida, Fam. Tschallener in Tyrol is run as an apartment hotel. The setting is quiet, offering scenic views of the surrounding mountains. The accommodation features apartments with a kitchenette, allowing for self-catering convenience. A breakfast service is available upon request. Amenities include a relaxing sauna area. The house is personally managed by the Tschallener family, ensuring a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The surrounding region offers direct access to hiking and biking trails as well as winter sports facilities. The property is well suited for guests valuing independence and tranquil surroundings.
